question_text: Explain how improved cellular wireless coverage supports a field engineer using a cloud repair application while travelling between sites.
adaptation_rationale: Make present network-infrastructure benefit explicit instead of historical growth speculation. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Coverage provides a network connection beyond a fixed office LAN, allowing the engineer’s mobile device to send and retrieve job updates from the cloud while moving between sites, with fewer gaps in service.

marking_points.criterion: Identifies mobile network access beyond fixed LAN.
Links connection to sending/retrieving cloud job data.
Explains wider coverage reduces disconnected periods while travelling.

acceptable_alternatives: Equivalent technically correct answers meeting the same scoped requirement; valid alternative algorithms accepted where they meet any explicit question constraints.
partial_credit_notes: Award each specified criterion independently up to the allocation. Credit correct method after an earlier slip when consistent; do not award the same point twice.
